edits.old: On Microsoft Marketplace, accepting a private offer agrees to its terms but does not complete the purchase. The buyer must also purchase or subscribe; standard SaaS flows additionally require vendor account configuration and confirmation, with a documented exception for Azure Native ISV offerings. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-15)
edits.new: On Microsoft Marketplace, for private offers that use separate acceptance and purchase, accepting the offer does not complete the purchase: the buyer must also purchase or subscribe, and billing starts only after the purchase steps. For SaaS, the buyer must additionally configure their account on the vendor's site to complete the purchase, with an exception for Azure Native ISV Services, where there is no Configure your account step and the purchase is complete once subscribing is done. Eligible offers can instead use single-click purchase, which accepts and purchases together. Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-overview ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offers-purchase ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/private-offer-troubleshoot
